27508-the-king-s-warrant-a-story-of-old-.title: A Story of Old and New France
27508-the-king-s-warrant-a-story-of-old-.creator: Unknown
27508-the-king-s-warrant-a-story-of-old-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. years past been far otherwise with their great dependencies beyond the Atlantic. There, during the years 1754 and 1755, New France and New England had already been carrying on a deadly conflict, which seemed to increase in intensity and fierceness as the months rolled on, and in which for some time the royal troops of both kingdoms had taken a prominent part, notwithstanding the nominal state of peace between the mother countries.

arxiv-2102-12760.title: Universal stereodynamics of cold atom-molecule collisions in electric fields
arxiv-2102-12760.creator: Timur V. Tscherbul 1 and Jacek Kłos 2
arxiv-2102-12760.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Timur V. Tscherbul 1 and Jacek Kłos 2. We use numerically exact quantum dynamics calculations to demonstrate universal stereoselectivity of cold collisions of Π 2 {}^{2}\Pi molecules with 1 S-state atoms in an external electric field.

arxiv-2108-02842.title: Multimodal Meta-Learning for Time Series Regression
arxiv-2108-02842.creator: Sebastian Pineda Arango, Felix Heinrich *, Kiran Madhusudhanan, Lars Schmidt-Thieme
arxiv-2108-02842.description: Abstract Recent work has shown the efficiency of deep learning models such as Fully Convolutional Networks (FCN) or Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) to deal with Time Series Regression (TSR) problems. These models sometimes need a lot of data to be able to generalize, yet the time series are sometimes not long enough to be able to learn patterns.

arxiv-2201-12364.title: The Link between Hot and Cool Outflows Volume: 366 Journal: The Origin of Outflows in Evolved Stars
arxiv-2201-12364.creator: Jorick S. Vink, A.A.C. Sander, E.R. Higgins, G.N. Sabhahit
arxiv-2201-12364.description: Abstract The link between hot and cool stellar outflows is shown to be critical for correctly predicting the masses of the most massive black holes (BHs) below the so-called pair-instability supernova (PISN) mass gap. Gravitational Wave (GW) event 190521 allegedly hosted an ”impossibly” heavy BH of 85 M ⊙ M_{\odot} .

arxiv-2308-15938.title: Provengo: A Tool Suite for Scenario Driven Model-Based Testing
arxiv-2308-15938.creator: Michael Bar-Sinai, Achiya Elyasaf, Gera Weiss, Yeshayahu Weiss
arxiv-2308-15938.description: Abstract We present Provengo, a comprehensive suite of tools designed to facilitate the implementation of Scenario-Driven Model-Based Testing (SDMBT), an innovative approach that utilizes scenarios to construct a model encompassing the user’s perspective and the system’s business value while also defining the desired outcomes.

arxiv-2310-15270.title: Scattering of classical gravitons with matter fields in the Null Surface Formulation
arxiv-2310-15270.creator: Carlos N. Kozameh, Emmanuel A. Tassone
arxiv-2310-15270.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Carlos N. Kozameh, Emmanuel A. Tassone. Using a set of field equations in the Null Surface Formulation we obtain the linearized coupling between the gravitational and matter fields. We first derive a formula for the metric of the space time and then we use this formula to study the scattering of incoming gravitational waves when matter is present, obtaining explicit formulae relating the radiation modes at past and future null infinity for a general asymptotically flat spacetime.

arxiv-2312-03860.title: Revisiting the cosmic string origin of GW190521
arxiv-2312-03860.creator: Josu C. Aurrekoetxea, Charlie Hoy, Mark Hannam
arxiv-2312-03860.description: Abstract For the first time we analyse gravitational-wave strain data using waveforms constructed from strong gravity simulations of cosmic string loops collapsing to Schwarzschild black holes; a previously unconsidered source. Since the expected signal is dominated by a black-hole ringdown, it can mimic the observed gravitational waves from high-mass binary black hole mergers.

arxiv-2408-02029.title: Mining Path Association Rules in Large Property Graphs (with Appendix)
arxiv-2408-02029.creator: Yuya Sasaki, Panagiotis Karras
arxiv-2408-02029.description: Abstract . How can we mine frequent path regularities from a graph with edge labels and vertex attributes? The task of association rule mining successfully discovers regular patterns in item sets and substructures. Still, to our best knowledge, this concept has not yet been extended to path patterns in large property graphs.

arxiv-2409-09418.title: Distributed Clustering based on Distributional Kernel Thanks: Hang Zhang and Yang Xu contribute equally to this work.
arxiv-2409-09418.creator: Hang Zhang, Yang Xu, Lei Gong, Ye Zhu, Kai Ming Ting
arxiv-2409-09418.description: Abstract . This paper introduces a new framework for clustering in a distributed network called Distributed Clustering based on Distributional Kernel ( 𝒦 \mathcal{K} ) or 𝒦 \mathcal{K} DC that produces the final clusters based on the similarity with respect to the distributions of initial clusters, as measured by 𝒦 \mathcal{K} .

arxiv-2504-11468.title: SFT or RL? An Early Investigation into Training R1-Like Reasoning Large Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2504-11468.creator: Hardy Chen, Haoqin Tu, Fali Wang, Hui Liu, Xianfeng Tang, Xinya Du, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie
arxiv-2504-11468.description: Abstract This work revisits the dominant supervised fine-tuning (SFT) then reinforcement learning (RL) paradigm for training Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and reveals a key finding: SFT can significantly undermine subsequent RL by inducing “pseudo reasoning paths” imitated from expert models.

arxiv-2509-10952.title: ImMimic: Cross-Domain Imitation from Human Videos via Mapping and Interpolation
arxiv-2509-10952.creator: Yangcen Liu, Woo Chul Shin, Yunhai Han, Zhenyang Chen, Danfei Xu
arxiv-2509-10952.description: Abstract Learning robot manipulation from abundant human videos offers a scalable alternative to costly robot-specific data collection. However, domain gaps across visual, morphological, and physical aspects hinder direct imitation. To effectively bridge the domain gap, we propose ImMimic , an embodiment-agnostic co-training framework that leverages both human videos and a small amount of teleoperated robot demonstrations.

arxiv-2509-25178.title: GHOST: Hallucination-Inducing Image Generation for Multimodal LLMs
arxiv-2509-25178.creator: Aryan Yazdan Parast, Parsa Hosseini, Hesam Asadollahzadeh, Arshia Soltani Moakhar, Basim Azam, Soheil Feizi, Naveed Akhtar
arxiv-2509-25178.description: Abstract Object hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is a persistent failure mode that causes the model to perceive objects absent in the image. This weakness of MLLMs is currently studied using static benchmarks with fixed visual scenarios, which preempts the possibility of uncovering model-specific or unanticipated hallucination vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2602-04085.title: BASS A I : Benchmarking Audio LMs for Musical Structure and Semantic Reasoning
arxiv-2602-04085.creator: Min Jang, Orevaoghene Ahia, Nazif Tamer, Sachin Kumar, Yulia Tsvetkov, Noah A. Smith
arxiv-2602-04085.description: Abstract Music understanding is a complex task that often requires reasoning over both structural and semantic elements of audio. We introduce BASS , designed to evaluate music understanding and reasoning in audio language models across four broad categories: structural segmentation, lyric transcription, musicological analysis, and artist collaboration.

arxiv-2602-22650.creator: Xinxin Yang, Yangyang Tang, Yikun Zhou, Yaolei Liu, Yun Li, Bo Yang
arxiv-2602-22650.description: Abstract . In online advertising, the inherent complexity and dynamic nature of advertising environments necessitate the use of auto-bidding services to assist advertisers in bid optimization. The complexity escalates in multi-channel scenarios, where effective allocation of budgets and constraints across channels with distinct behavioral patterns becomes critical for optimizing return on investment.

openalex-w2920135474.creator: Moritz U. G. Kraemer, Robert C. Reiner, Oliver J. Brady, Jane P. Messina, Marius Gilbert, David M. Pigott, Dingdong Yi, Kimberly B. Johnson, Lucas Earl, Laurie B. Marczak, Shreya Shirude, Nicole Davis Weaver

pmc-10539446.title: Biomolecular condensates modulate membrane lipid packing and hydration
pmc-10539446.creator: Agustín Mangiarotti, Macarena Siri, Nicky W Tam, Ziliang Zhao, Leonel Malacrida, Rumiana Dimova
pmc-10539446.description: Membrane wetting by biomolecular condensates recently emerged as a key phenomenon in cell biology, playing an important role in a diverse range of processes across different organisms. However, an understanding of the molecular mechanisms behind condensate formation and interaction with lipid membranes is still missing.

pmc-11453295.title: 8072 Crosstalk between E-cadherin loss and Estrogen receptor drives tumorigenesis in Invasive Lobular Carcinoma
pmc-11453295.creator: Chinasa A Ufondu, Maggie Musick, Matthew Joseph Sikora, Julie Hanson Ostrander
pmc-11453295.description: Disclosure: C.A. Ufondu: None. M. Musick: None. M.J. Sikora: None. J.H. Ostrander: None.Estrogen receptor (ER) expression and E-cadherin (CDH1) loss are the two major molecular hallmarks of invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC) of the breast; however, it is unclear how ER signaling and E-cadherin loss crosstalk during ILC tumor formation.

pmc-11640424.title: Thermal Liquid Biopsy: A Promising Tool for the Differential Diagnosis of Pancreatic Cystic Lesions and Malignancy Detection
pmc-11640424.creator: Judith Millastre, Sonia Hermoso-Durán, María Ortiz de Solórzano, Nicolas Fraunhoffer, Guillermo García-Rayado, Sonia Vega, Luis Bujanda, Carlos Sostres, Ángel Lanas, Adrián Velázquez-Campoy, Olga Abian
pmc-11640424.description: Simple SummaryMucinous epithelial pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are premalignant lesions detectable through imaging techniques; however, distinguishing them from other PCLs with lower malignancy potential is challenging. Current methods like biochemical markers and genomic studies are not always reliable. Thermal liquid biopsy (TLB) is an innovative tool that analyzes the thermal profile of biological samples to detect disease-related alterations.

pmc-12475861.title: Epigenetic co-regulator HCF-1 promotes lung cancer via O-GlcNAcylation-dependent pathways
pmc-12475861.creator: Priyanka P. Srivastava, Abhilash Dasari, Saran Kumar, Ishaan Gupta, Deepali Jain, Shilpi Minocha
pmc-12475861.description: The rise in the incidences of lung cancer currently poses a global health challenge, making it crucial to understand the underlying molecular and cellular mechanisms. Host cell factor-1 (HCF-1), a conserved epigenetic transcriptional co-regulator, undergoes proteolytic maturation and glycosylation by O-linked N-acetylglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) transferase (OGT).

pmc-12667046.title: Registered nurses’ perceptions of food and mealtimes in palliative care: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12667046.creator: Viktoria Wallin, Andreas Rosenblad, Carina Lundh Hagelin, Anna Klarare
pmc-12667046.description: BackgroundFood and mealtimes are fundamental aspects of human wellbeing, both considering physiological aspects of human life and social interactions. Since registered nurses are key caregivers in palliative care, the aim of this study was to explore registered nurses’ perceptions of food and mealtimes in palliative care.

pmc-12718663.title: Limb Salvage Through Endovascular Repair of an Iatrogenic Superficial Femoral Artery Pseudoaneurysm Following Femoral Fracture Fixation
pmc-12718663.creator: Zubair Farooq, Anees A Nengroo, Jasbir S Randhawa, Amit Sharma
pmc-12718663.description: Vascular injury leading to pseudoaneurysm formation is a rare but potentially limb-threatening complication of lower limb trauma and postoperative recovery. We report a case of a 58-year-old man who developed progressive swelling of the right thigh one week after sustaining a road traffic accident and undergoing intramedullary nailing for a distal femoral shaft fracture.

pmc-12729281.title: Wound-Healing Potential of Engineered Lysin GRC-ML07 in Pseudomonas aeruginosa Infected Wounds in Immunocompromised Mice
pmc-12729281.creator: Mariam Abdulkadieva, Darya Slonova, Veronika Litvinenko, Nataliia Antonova, Elena Mazunina, Konstantin Sobyanin, Tatiana Guseva, Olga Parshina, Pavel Domnin, Vladislav Poloskov, Vladimir Guschin, Daria Vasina, Elena Sysolyatina, Alexander Gintsburg
pmc-12729281.description: Objectives: The study aimed to evaluate the antibacterial and wound-healing potential of the engineered lysin GRC-ML07 in a mouse model of full-thickness wounds infected with multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa under immunosuppression. Methods: Male BALB/c mice (22–24 g) were immunocompromised with cyclophosphamide. Three days later, full-thickness excisional wounds were created and infected with P. aeruginosa (107 cells/wound).

pmc-12953314.title: Neuroactive steroids for the treatment of depression and anxiety: gaps and promises
pmc-12953314.creator: Rainer Rupprecht, Cornelius Schüle, Thomas Gudermann
pmc-12953314.description: one is a synthetic 3α-reduced neuroactive steroid and an allosteric modulator of γ-aminobutyric acid type A (GABAA) receptors. As such, it is time to put the approval of zuranolone in the context of unmet treatment needs and the neurosteroid research field and its potential for the treatment of affective disorders.

pmc-13059233.title: Risk stratification and data-driven phenotyping of peripherally inserted central catheter-related bloodstream infection: an explainable machine learning analysis of a large critical care cohort
pmc-13059233.creator: Yujia Liu, Chao Cong, Dongsheng Cheng
pmc-13059233.description: BackgroundPeripherally inserted central catheter-related bloodstream infections (PICC-CRBSIs) are significant causes of morbidity and mortality in critically ill patients. Therefore, improved risk stratification is required for targeted prevention. This study aimed to identify key predictors and novel patient phenotypes of PICC-CRBSI using explainable machine learning.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study using data from the MIMIC-IV Critical Care database.

pmc-13347293.title: Fabrication of UiO-66(Zr)–NH2-encapsulated boehmite–chitosan granules and their application for adsorptive denitrogenation of liquid fuel
pmc-13347293.creator: The Ky Vo, Phan Huynh Anh, Dang Thi Thanh Nhan, Van Cuong Nguyen, Van Son Nguyen, Van Thanh Khue
pmc-13347293.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Herein, boehmite–chitosan granules (d ∼ 2–3 mm) encapsulating different amounts of UiO-66(Zr)–NH2 (BCS@UN-x) were efficiently prepared using a combined sol–gel and oil-drop method. The granules were characterised using FE-SEM, XRD, FT-IR, TGA, XPS, and N2 sorption. Incorporating UiO-66(Zr)–NH2 frameworks into the boehmite-crosslinked chitosan matrix yielded composite granules with enhanced porosity and stability, as well as a higher abundance of functional groups, which are beneficial for the adsorption of N-containing compounds (NCCs) from n-octane.

pmc-13354631.title: Breast cancer phenotypes in carriers of pathogenic POT1 variants
pmc-13354631.creator: Tal Hadar, Aasem Abu Shtaya, Rinat Bernstein-Molho, Marina Eskin-Schwartz, Inbal Kedar, Tamar Peretz-Yablonsky, Shiri Shkedi-Rafid, Rinat Yerushalmi, Aviad Zick, Gili Reznick-Levi, Tanir Allweis, Yael Goldberg
pmc-13354631.description: Germline pathogenic variants (PVs) in POT1, one of the shelterin complex genes, correlate with tumor predisposition, primarily with melanoma, hematologic malignancies, sarcoma, papillary thyroid carcinoma and glioma. Breast cancer (BC) risk has not been shown to be elevated. We analyzed BC occurrence and features in a cohort of 29 female PV heterozygotes, of whom 13/29 (45%) were diagnosed with BC.

pmc-13589385.creator: Chunjie Huang, Sichang He
pmc-13589385.description: ObjectivesTo examine the longitudinal associations between sensory impairment and multimorbidity among middle-aged and older adults in China, and to explore whether activities of daily living (ADL) mediate these associations.MethodsData were drawn from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS), including the baseline wave in 2011 and follow-up waves in 2015 and 2018.
